req.title: Player creation persists to DB
req.statement: The system shall commit newly created players to the players table so subsequent GET requests return them.

doc.reasoning: R-PLAYER-019 requires that POST /players/ commits a new player to the DB and that a subsequent GET returns it. Tests must cover: (1) positive EP — valid new player returns 201 and is retrievable via GET; (2) negative NEG — duplicate squad_number returns 409 and is not double-inserted; (3) boundary BVA — squad_number at the boundary of existing data (27, one above the highest seeded value 26) to catch off-by-one mutations; (4) DT — missing required field returns 422 (client error path); (5) STC — state transition: POST then GET by squad number confirms persistence. All tests use in-process FastAPI TestClient, exact status codes, and exact field assertions to maximise mutation kill rate.

tests.name: test_post_player_valid_persists_and_get_returns_201_then_200
preconditions: DB is loaded with 26 seeded rows
Squad number 99 does not exist in the seeded data
actions: POST /players/ with a fully populated valid PlayerRequestModel payload using squad_number=99
Assert response JSON contains all submitted fields plus a UUID id
Assert GET response status is exactly 200
Assert GET response JSON fields match the POSTed payload
expected: Response body contains id (UUID), firstName='Test', lastName='Player', squadNumber=99, position='Goalkeeper'
GET body matches the created player
trace: R-PLAYER-019: newly created player committed to DB
R-PLAYER-019: subsequent GET returns the created player
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app)

payload = {
    "firstName": "Test",
    "middleName": None,
    "lastName": "Player",
    "dateOfBirth": "1990-01-01T00:00:00.000Z",
    "squadNumber": 99,
    "position": "Goalkeeper",
    "abbrPosition": "GK",
    "team": "Test FC",
    "league": "Test League",
    "starting11": False
}

def test_post_player_valid_persists_and_get_returns_201_then_200():
    post_r = client.post("/players/", json=payload)
    assert post_r.status_code == 201
    body = post_r.json()
    assert body["firstName"] == "Test"
    assert body["lastName"] == "Player"
    assert body["squadNumber"] == 99
    assert body["position"] == "Goalkeeper"
    assert body["abbrPosition"] == "GK"
    assert body["team"] == "Test FC"
    assert body["league"] == "Test League"
    assert body["starting11"] == False
    assert "id" in body
    get_r = client.get("/players/squadnumber/99")
    assert get_r.status_code == 200
    get_body = get_r.json()
    assert get_body["squadNumber"] == 99
    assert get_body["firstName"] == "Test"
    assert get_body["lastName"] == "Player"
    assert get_body["id"] == body["id"]

tests.name: test_post_player_duplicate_squad_number_returns_409
preconditions: DB is loaded with 26 seeded rows
Squad number 10 (Messi) already exists in the seeded data
actions: Assert response JSON detail contains conflict message
GET /players/squadnumber/10 to confirm original record unchanged
expected: Response detail is 'A Player with this squad number already exists.'
GET /players/squadnumber/10 still returns Messi's record unchanged
trace: R-PLAYER-019: error pathway HTTP 4xx on client error (duplicate)
Route raises HTTPException 409 when squad_number already exists
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app)

def test_post_player_duplicate_squad_number_returns_409():
    payload = {
        "firstName": "Duplicate",
        "lastName": "Player",
        "squadNumber": 10,
        "position": "Right Winger"
    }
    post_r = client.post("/players/", json=payload)
    assert post_r.status_code == 409
    body = post_r.json()
    assert body["detail"] == "A Player with this squad number already exists."
    get_r = client.get("/players/squadnumber/10")
    assert get_r.status_code == 200
    get_body = get_r.json()
    assert get_body["firstName"] == "Lionel"
    assert get_body["lastName"] == "Messi"
    assert get_body["squadNumber"] == 10

tests.name: test_post_player_state_transition_not_found_then_created_then_retrievable
preconditions: DB is loaded with 26 seeded rows
Squad number 50 does not exist in the seeded data
actions: Assert all fields in GET response match the POSTed payload exactly
expected: POST returns HTTP 201 with correct payload
GET body fields match POST payload exactly (firstName, lastName, squadNumber, position, starting11)
trace: R-PLAYER-019: state transition from non-existent to persisted
STC: covers the full lifecycle state change triggered by POST
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app)

def test_post_player_state_transition_not_found_then_created_then_retrievable():
    pre_get = client.get("/players/squadnumber/50")
    assert pre_get.status_code == 404
    payload = {
        "firstName": "State",
        "middleName": "Trans",
        "lastName": "Ition",
        "dateOfBirth": "1995-05-15T00:00:00.000Z",
        "squadNumber": 50,
        "position": "Left Winger",
        "abbrPosition": "LW",
        "team": "STC United",
        "league": "STC League",
        "starting11": True
    }
    post_r = client.post("/players/", json=payload)
    assert post_r.status_code == 201
    post_body = post_r.json()
    assert post_body["squadNumber"] == 50
    assert post_body["firstName"] == "State"
    assert post_body["lastName"] == "Ition"
    assert post_body["starting11"] == True
    post_get = client.get("/players/squadnumber/50")
    assert post_get.status_code == 200
    get_body = post_get.json()
    assert get_body["squadNumber"] == 50
    assert get_body["firstName"] == "State"
    assert get_body["middleName"] == "Trans"
    assert get_body["lastName"] == "Ition"
    assert get_body["position"] == "Left Winger"
    assert get_body["abbrPosition"] == "LW"
    assert get_body["team"] == "STC United"
    assert get_body["league"] == "STC League"
    assert get_body["starting11"] == True
    assert get_body["id"] == post_body["id"]

tests.name: test_post_player_location_header_points_to_created_resource
preconditions: DB is loaded with 26 seeded rows
Squad number 77 does not exist in the seeded data
actions: Follow the Location header with a GET request
expected: GET to Location returns HTTP 200 with correct player data
trace: R-PLAYER-019: Location header correctness after creation
EP: catches mutations to the Location header construction or squad_number substitution
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app)

def test_post_player_location_header_points_to_created_resource():
    payload = {
        "firstName": "Location",
        "lastName": "Header",
        "squadNumber": 77,
        "position": "Defensive Midfield",
        "abbrPosition": "DM",
        "starting11": False
    }
    post_r = client.post("/players/", json=payload)
    assert post_r.status_code == 201
    assert post_r.headers["location"] == "/players/squadnumber/77"
    get_r = client.get("/players/squadnumber/77")
    assert get_r.status_code == 200
    get_body = get_r.json()
    assert get_body["squadNumber"] == 77
    assert get_body["firstName"] == "Location"
    assert get_body["lastName"] == "Header"
    assert get_body["starting11"] == False

tests.name: test_post_player_squad_number_26_boundary_at_max_seeded_returns_409
preconditions: DB is loaded with 26 seeded rows
Squad number 26 (Molina) exists in the seeded data
actions: POST /players/ with squad_number=26 (exactly the highest seeded value)
Assert response status is exactly 409 (conflict, not 201)
Assert detail message is the exact conflict string
expected: detail is 'A Player with this squad number already exists.'
No new player created at squad_number=26
trace: R-PLAYER-019: boundary at max seeded squad_number (26) must conflict
BVA: catches off-by-one mutations that might allow 26 to slip through as new
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app)

def test_post_player_squad_number_26_boundary_at_max_seeded_returns_409():
    payload = {
        "firstName": "Boundary",
        "lastName": "Conflict",
        "squadNumber": 26,
        "position": "Right-Back"
    }
    post_r = client.post("/players/", json=payload)
    assert post_r.status_code == 409
    body = post_r.json()
    assert body["detail"] == "A Player with this squad number already exists."
    get_r = client.get("/players/squadnumber/26")
    assert get_r.status_code == 200
    get_body = get_r.json()
    assert get_body["firstName"] == "Nahuel"
    assert get_body["lastName"] == "Molina"
    assert get_body["squadNumber"] == 26
